description: Keeps the manually-pinned toolchain current: SHA-pinned GitHub Actions, the Makefile's go-run tool pins (@ vX.Y.Z), npm, docker, and the Go module deps.

customManagers.description: Makefile-pinned go-run tools (sqlc, oapi-codegen, vacuum, govulncheck), written as module@version for this match

packageRules.description: oapi-codegen output and vacuum rules change with generator versions; batch them with the codegen pins they belong to.
The npm generator pin lives in web/package.json scripts; Renovate's npm manager covers openapi-typescript there.
